<parameter name="next_thought">alter_existing_thesis returned AAPL.p3 as supporting, and revise_projections returned no change, so the projection step is done. The claims also raise a debate that no pillar mentions: the in-house C2 modem's displacement of Qualcomm, its certification and yield problems, and the target mix reset. AAPL.p3 covers component costs and margin, but no pillar addresses modem sourcing or the in-house chip program. Rule 4 permits a new-thesis check for that debate. This is the third and final tool call, and it passes only AAPL's modem-related claims.</parameter>
